## 表达矩阵预览

```{=typst}
#report-intro("表达矩阵以 TPM 为单位，样本列按分组及组内输入顺序排列。表格只提供预览，完整数据保留在原始交付文件中。")
```

```{python}
#| label: pdf-matrix
#| output: asis
matrix = pd.read_csv(tpm_file, sep="\t", index_col=0)
metadata = pd.read_csv(meta_file) if meta_file else None
if metadata is not None:
    from bioreport.utils.pdf_results import ordered_samples
    columns = ordered_samples(metadata, matrix.columns)
else: columns = list(matrix.columns)
shown = matrix[columns[:pdf_settings.get('matrix_columns',6)]].reset_index()
shown = shown.rename(columns={shown.columns[0]:'Gene ID'})
preview(shown, tpm_file, limit=pdf_settings.get('matrix_rows',8))
typst_note(f'正文展示 {min(len(columns),pdf_settings.get("matrix_columns",6))} / {len(matrix.columns)} 个样本列。')
```
